title: BariSurg- Sleeve gastrectomy versus Roux-en-Y gastric bypass in obese patients with BMI 35-60 kg/m² - a multicenter randomized trial
summary: The study compares excess weight loss after two and five years, morbidity, mortality, course of obesity related disease, course of gastrooesophageal reflux diseases and quality of life in patients with a BMI of 35-60 kg / kg² after 2 different surgical procedures in obesity surgery (sleeve gastrectomy and gastric bypass).

interventions.name: gastric bypass (gastrojejunostomie and Roux-en Y jejunojejunostomie)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Age, BMI 35-60 kg/m² according to the German S3 guidelines, preoperative psychosomatic and endocrinological investigation without contraindication to bariatric surgery, signed Informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Pregnancy, malignant disease in the past five years. Expected lack of compliance or inability to informed consent, ASA IV, previous bariatric surgery, History of major abdominal operation
central: Prof. Dr. med. Franck Billmann · Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg Sektion Minimal Invasive Chirurgie · 06221- 5634411 · franck.billmann@med.uni-heidelberg.de
